name: C2-4 Depth without activation
description: Two linear layers collapse into one

data.noteContent:
The same graph as the ReLU one beside it -- same data, same two hidden layers of 16, same optimiser -- with activation set to identity. Nothing bends between the layers, so the two matrix multiplies collapse into one: W2 . W1 . x + b is still a single straight boundary.

The accuracy Print reads 0.4, 24 of 60, no better than the straight-line classifier this was meant to improve on. The training loss stops at 0.693, which is ln 2 -- exactly the loss of a model that answers half and half to every point.

Run this and the ReLU example side by side and compare the two numbers. Depth on its own bought nothing.

這張圖和旁邊用 ReLU 的那張一模一樣 -- 同一份資料、同樣兩層各 16 個單元、同一個最佳化器 -- 只把 activation 設成 identity。層與層之間沒有任何彎折，兩次矩陣相乘就塌成一次：W2 . W1 . x + b 仍然只是一條直線邊界。

準確率的 Print 是 0.4，60 題對 24 題，並沒有比它想勝過的那個直線分類器好。訓練損失停在 0.693，也就是 ln 2 -- 對每個點都回答「一半一半」的模型，損失正好是這個數。

把這張圖和用 ReLU 的那張並排跑，對照兩個數字。光有深度什麼也沒買到。

activation is the only difference from the ReLU example. identity means no function at all is applied after the matrix multiply, and a stack of linear maps is one linear map. Set it back to relu here, touch nothing else, and the accuracy jumps to 1.0.

activation 是這張圖和用 ReLU 那張唯一的差別。identity 表示矩陣相乘之後不再套任何函數，而一串線性映射合起來還是一個線性映射。在這裡把它改回 relu、其他都不動，準確率就會跳到 1.0。
